claim: UNHCR published dated displacement-overview products for 5, 12, 19 and 26 July 2021, confirming a contemporaneous weekly observation chain suitable for cutoff-specific reconstruction.
limitations: This row validates sensor chronology only; numeric totals remain unimported until underlying map/PDF values are extracted and checked.

claim: On 19 May 2021 the NUG Ministry of Planning, Finance and Investment issued a certificate recording a KRW 12,548,000 donation from the Anti-Coup Committee (Korea)-Myanmar Democracy Network Forces for ending military dictatorship and establishing a federal democratic union.
limitations: A single documented donation proves existence of a diaspora support channel, not its total scale, continuity or allocation to armed activity.

claim: NUG humanitarian ministry reported a May 2021 meeting with Myanmar communities in Japan, Singapore and South Korea and a 10.4 million MMK donation for ethnic people affected by the coup.
limitations: Humanitarian support must not be conflated with military financing; source is the recipient institution and needs independent corroboration for scale claims.

claim: ACLED's contemporaneous 2021 analysis described multiple local defense groups, some aligned with the NUG PDF and others independent; as of 30 June around 40 had been recorded by ACLED as active in organized political violence, with wide variation in resources and capacity.
limitations: ACLED coverage is event-based and incomplete; active-group count is not a census of all resistance organizations. Formation does not imply size, armament or unified command.

claim: NUG humanitarian ministry stated in June 2021 that community-based and civil-society organizations were essential partners for reaching people and invited cooperation with ethnic organizations, documenting an intended decentralized support network.
limitations: Institutional declaration shows intended network architecture, not verified reach or outcome.
